response.markdown_report:
**Recommendation:** test a jointly trained, scratch-initialized title/description embedding inside the corrected HSTU, using multi-negative sampled softmax. This targets specific relevance and format-sensitive ranking while retaining one network per category. Gains remain unmeasured.

**Insights from the starting point**

1. Electronics has 10.71% sampled wrong rankings and a −0.0749 tenth-percentile margin. Improving discrimination is better supported than adding embedding-diversity penalties.
2. Collapse scores near 0.5 imply average cosine similarity near zero. They do not establish substantial directional collapse.
3. Users reject broad associations and overlooked format or connector differences. Titles and descriptions offer possible evidence, but neither completed needs nor physical compatibility is labeled.

**Insights from related work**

1. [HSTU’s configuration](https://github.com/meta-recsys/generative-recommenders/blob/main/configs/ml-1m/hstu-sampled-softmax-n128-final.gin) provides a normalized, temperature-scaled sampled-softmax reference. Its MovieLens settings are starting hypotheses for Amazon.
2. [SCE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.18721) motivates informative negatives. Unobserved items can nevertheless be relevant, so aggressive mining risks false negatives.
3. [MMSR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.17372v1) motivates joint content and sequence representations. Its pretrained encoders do not establish effectiveness for the required scratch-trained adaptation.

**Framework and candidate assessment**

Scores are prospective judgments, not experimental results. O/P/U/M/D denote originality, potential, user alignment, model alignment, and implementation difficulty; higher D means harder.

| Direction / atomic idea | O/P/U/M/D | Positive assessment | Negative assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Objective: moderate hard-negative curriculum, following SCE | 3/7/5/9/3 | Directly targets weak margins with little architecture work | Limited novelty; false negatives; no explicit compatibility evidence |
| Temporal representation: jointly learned recent-history gate within HSTU | 4/7/8/5/5 | Targets stale interests and completed-need recommendations | Need completion is unobserved; margin benefit is uncertain |
| Item representation: scratch text residual inside HSTU, following MMSR | 4/8/9/8/5 | Shares specific attributes across items and supports discrimination | Sparse text may limit learning; attributes do not prove compatibility |

**Selected experiment**

At 0% progress, choose the text residual: a small trainable token-embedding mean and projection added to each item-ID embedding. Preserve model numbers, units, connectors, and media formats during tokenization. This explicitly targets **broad thematic recommendations** and **overlooked format/connector distinctions**. Its model-facing target is Electronics’ weak separation; neither improvement is guaranteed.

```python
text = masked_mean(token_embedding(item_tokens))
item = id_embedding + sigmoid(text_gate) * projection(text)
features = corrected_hstu(left_padded_history, item)
loss = sampled_softmax(features, positive, uniform_negatives)
```

Use training histories only to exclude known positives from negatives. Keep the candidate objective identical in an ID-only ablation to isolate text’s effect. Maintain seeds 0/42, all four routes, at most 200 epochs and 200 batches/epoch. Read the final nonpadding position; serialize text vocabulary, token tables, architecture and weights into each category’s single checkpoint. Update the predictor writer and diagnostic adapters consistently. Select by fixed macro validation HR@10; report Electronics separately. Never interpret training margins as held-out gains.

idea.description: Add a small, randomly initialized title/description residual to the corrected HSTU’s shared item representations. Train the text encoder, item embeddings and HSTU jointly as one network per category.
idea.motivation: Targets two observed user failures: broad thematic relevance replacing specific intent, and overlooked connector or media-format distinctions. Multi-negative next-item training targets the measured weak positive–negative separation in Electronics. Available text supplies possible clues, not compatibility labels or evidence that a need is fulfilled.
idea.implementation_notes: Build vocabulary from supplied training-accessible metadata without external weights. Preserve informative numbers, units, connector names and formats; use a zero text residual for missing metadata. Initialize a global trainable text gate conservatively. Use the fused representation consistently for history inputs and candidate scoring, with padding fixed to zero. Keep HSTU gating, causal attention and position/time mechanisms intact. Compare against an ID-only model using the same explicit normalization, temperature and negative count; the official 128-negative, temperature-0.05 configuration is a reference, not a proven optimum. Preserve DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], routing, supplied splits, seed settings and training limits. Each category predictor loads one checkpoint containing all learned parameters and text preprocessing artifacts. Preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), ModelView and family-specific sample_batch compatibility; diagnostics must score the actual fused representations. Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returning metrics and metric_definitions, and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Treat unavailable category metadata as unavailable rather than inventing breakdowns. No measured validation result is claimed.
idea.pseudocode:
For each of the four categories:
  Set training seed 42; retain host preprocessing seed 0 and supplied splits.
  Tokenize available titles/descriptions; save vocabulary and item token table.
  Initialize one corrected HSTU with a scratch text residual.
  For each of at most 200 epochs, run 200 training batches:
    Sample the family-specific causal next-item batch.
    Fuse item-ID embeddings with gated projected mean token embeddings.
    Compute HSTU features with left-padding and causal masks.
    Sample uniform negatives, excluding padding, targets and known training positives.
    Optimize explicitly configured multi-negative sampled softmax on valid positions.
  Evaluate with the unchanged host validation protocol.
  Save one selected checkpoint, including text parameters and preprocessing artifacts.
Write working/predict.py through the predictor writer using the identical architecture.
At prediction, gather the final nonpadding position, never count-1.
Run preserved diagnostic interfaces using actual fused item scores.

originality.positive: Adapts joint content and sequential learning to a constrained scratch-trained HSTU with attribute-preserving tokenization.
originality.negative: Text and item-ID fusion is established; novelty is primarily the constrained adaptation.

future_potential.positive: Offers a testable route toward attribute-sensitive ranking and shared learning for sparsely observed items.
future_potential.negative: Short or incomplete metadata and insufficient scratch-training signal may limit generalization.

code_difficulty.positive: A token mean, projection and gate require modest architecture changes and no external encoder.
code_difficulty.negative: Shared candidate representations, checkpoint serialization, diagnostic compatibility and predictor consistency require careful implementation.

related_work.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
contributions: Introduces HSTU with pointwise attention and multiplicative feature interactions.
Provides the required backbone family for the proposed extension.
limitations: Does not establish the proposed scratch-trained text residual’s effectiveness on these four Amazon datasets.

related_work.title: Official HSTU MovieLens sampled-softmax configuration
contributions: Provides a concrete reference using 128 negatives, normalized representations and temperature 0.05.
limitations: MovieLens settings are not evidence of optimal Amazon hyperparameters.

related_work.title: Scalable Cross-Entropy
contributions: Motivates learning from informative catalog candidates through approximate maximum-inner-product search.
limitations: Does not demonstrate gains under this fixed HSTU benchmark.
Informative unobserved candidates may include false negatives.

related_work.title: MMSR
contributions: Studies joint adaptation of content encoders and sequential recommendation modules and their fusion.
limitations: Uses pretrained content encoders, which are unavailable under this task’s constraints.
Does not validate the proposed randomly initialized text encoder.
